sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 was used for 2 transactions totalling $187.33 that the bank believes were unauthorised. The activity ran through the online channel under product code C, in billing region 191. The identity record marks the device as New for this account using the profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. The connection used an anonymous proxy denoted as IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS. This device profile has been used on the card before. A fraud analyst asked for this card to be reviewed alongside related activity. One device profile is being used across many unrelated cards in the same weeks, always marked new for each account and usually behind an anonymous proxy. The purchases are ordinary in size, which keeps the bank's model quiet, and the link between the cardholders is the device rather than anything about the cards. The same device profile links this activity to 19 other cards, which indicates one actor operating across several cardholders. The total suspicious amount is $187.33. The recommended actions for this case are BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
